cards.title: copy the virtual clock from user repo and set up test harness

C:\source\pm\sinsforreal-private-machine
this person made a test against their companion on github. very valuable work, their result is here: "C:\source\pm\private-machine\docs\ab_test_2026-10-23.md"
i want you to create a backtest harness in C:\source\pm\private-machine\simulation
it should be a completely seperate part of the software suit. i want to make my project compatible to their harness, so they wont have to fix or change stuff in the future. and i want my harness to use the same api so i can run it myself. 
i want to start the harness, and see a overview of all my characters. i can select a run (a char from the .pm/private-machine) folder and see the chatlog. for example, i want to open it, start a new backtest run, load my spamuel data. then i open a winodw where i can set up the backtest with a scenario script. "jesse comes home and reports that she found a stray cat and wants to keep it. she keeps it no matter what. she goes to sleep around midnight, and wakes up at 7:00 and finds out the shit pooped in her bed. she still wants to keep it because cats are cute." this would set up agents solely for simulating jesse, fully in the harness suite. spamuel would be be executed fully in the private-machine archiecture. the vclock is used to simualte time passing. the log folders should be fixed, all pm-coder sessions should go the correct persona folder. if we don't already do it, we must capture telemetry data. when the run is done (script is finished, director agent decides to stop run) everything is written to a nice report for later analyzing. this should completely replace the outdated backtest engine we have right now, and serve an integral part in testing going forward. minecraft should be disabled for now. design is in a way so that in the future i can replace jesse with another pm instance. or better yet, design it so that i can link multiple personas togehter. simulate 3 agents that can talk to another agents. this will be important for minecraft teambased play simulation and backtests later. 
scrap C:/source/pm/private-machine/dev/review
this will be central to auditing changes and refining the cognitive architecture. the next task will be k003, a memory debugger on steroids. don't implement it, but keep it in mind. k003 will be very modular, and should later be integrated into the backtest harness.
also, important: only write ghost backups when the main cognition cycle finishes, and clear all knoxels that aren't causally connected.
when i chat with the bot, write something while it still thinks and send it, and it makes a reply (the workflow hasn't seen my new message), it creates the backup where its reply is the last entry. since that reply isn't causally connected to my message, my message will be trimmed. when i then load the backup, i see its latest message, but my last message is gone.
